title: Absorption
description: Whether heavy flow is moving the price or being soaked up. Flow that fails to move the price is being absorbed by patient liquidity.

state.label: Absorption state
state.description: Absorbing when strong flow has barely moved the price, responding when it has, and quiet when there is little flow. Absorbing flow often reverses.

flow_direction.label: Flow direction
flow_direction.description: Which way the recent aggressive flow is pointed, buy or sell. Read it with the state to see whether that flow is winning.

flow_to_depth_ratio.label: Flow vs depth
flow_to_depth_ratio.description: Signed flow over ten seconds against the depth it hit. Above one means flow was bigger than the book could hold.

price_response_bps_10s.label: Price response 10s
price_response_bps_10s.description: How far the price moved over the same ten seconds, in basis points. Small against big flow means absorption.
